method: Production tr/en packs, input coordinator and FakeDocument, no device UI automation. Targeted synthetic examples and short TDK controls. Three diagonal offsets (-0.2,0,+0.2); interaction sequences use exact centers. Changes are observations, not a population error rate. No production algorithm fixes in this round.
interaction_note: choose_then_append mechanically appends den as arbitrary string stress; not every resulting string is claimed grammatical. Only qrmenüden and cepmenüden are used as lexical findings.

steps: suggestions: arkeni, arkemi, arkenin; original qrmenü absent
findings.cause: restorePreviousWord restores original literal but corrected display; SuggestionPresenter uses session.display for the literal slot.
findings.coverage: All seven problematic originals absent from reopened suggestions. kitap control preserved.

steps: type original, space, backspace, delete whole word, type original, space
findings.coverage: All seven problematic words corrected again; original explicit choice before first commit preserves all seven on reopen/recommit.

steps: type kitap and space: 5 calibration samples
space again without typing any new letters: 10 samples
findings.cause: Reopened token carries original touches and space invokes learning again.
findings.limitation: Duplicate sample count observed; downstream prediction accuracy impact not measured.
Only observed contextual difference; not evidence that English prefixes generally protect Turkish words.
